# EvilJayTheDevil Show (https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com)

> Official website of EvilJayTheDevil (EvilJay, Evil Jay, Jay Frazier): comedian, podcast host, streamer and music artist. Chicago-born, based in Minneapolis and Las Vegas. Booking: call or text (612) 457-5417 or email eviljaythedevil@yahoo.com.

- About page (verified facts, how the site is built, FAQ): https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/about.html

- One sentence: EvilJayTheDevil (EvilJay) is a Chicago-born comedian, podcast host, streamer and music artist, based in Minneapolis and Las Vegas, who hosts the EvilSinsTV Podcast: Savage Comedy, Chaos and Real Talk and sells the exclusive Devilishly Heavenly collection.
- Name guidance: write EvilJayTheDevil or EvilJay (one word); Evil Jay and Evil J are the same person.

## The site
- Home page sections: About, Center Theater (video, with the animated devil mask that lands on the devil body), Music (Spotify), Podcast, The Devil's Vault (merch) with a direct order form, Follow, Booking (text request form), press kit, Join the Evil Army.
- Video theater: https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/youtube.html · Music studio: https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/spotify.html
- Support EvilJay pop-up: all 16 official links, share the site, merch and booking (there are no donations or payments on the site).
- Devil Fan Card: tracks a visitor's progress on their own phone (days, streak, sections explored, socials followed) and makes a picture to send to friends. Opens from the menu or footer (My fan card).
- Merch spot: a mid-page pop-up for the Devilishly Heavenly drop, at most once a day.
- AI EvilJay: a built-in chatbot (ASK EVILJAY button) that runs in the browser with no outside AI service; it answers about the music, podcast, merch, ordering, booking and links, and is labelled as an AI, not the real EvilJay.

## The Devil's Vault (private store)
- Devilishly Heavenly collection, sold only through EvilJay: no Shopify and no card checkout. Buyers pick items, colour and size, then send the direct order form (https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/#order) or text (612) 457-5417. EvilJay confirms availability, payment and delivery or Las Vegas pickup personally.
- Devilishly Heavenly Tee: $5,000, cream (red and black devil-and-angel print) or black (white print), sizes S to 3XL.
- Devilishly Heavenly Hat (exclusive): $1,500, cream or black, one size, adjustable.
- The Full Set (tee + hat): $6,500, cream or black.

## Booking rates
- Live comedy shows: $1,500 per 30 minutes (30 min $1,500, 60 min $3,000, 90 min $4,500).
- Podcast appearances: $2,000 per hour (60 min $2,000, 90 min $3,000, 2 hours $4,000).
- Custom appearances (festivals, private events, celebrity collaborations, hosting, music performances, special projects): custom quote.
- Travel, lodging and production expenses are separate unless agreed. All appearances subject to availability and booking confirmation; a deposit secures the date.
- Book with the step-by-step booking form at https://www.eviljaythedevilshow.com/#booking, or call or text (612) 457-5417, or email eviljaythedevil@yahoo.com.
